title: Work result
description: What a producing model returns. It describes what was done and what was decided; the candidate itself is the worktree, and the driver builds the envelope. A model never hand-writes protocol data.

summary.description: What was built, in the worker's own words. Not the interface between steps — the envelope is.

changed_paths.description: Every path the worker believes it changed. The scope gate checks the worktree rather than trusting this, but a disagreement between the two is itself a signal.

decisions.description: Choices the contract did not settle. An ambiguity resolved silently is the one that surprises a reviewer.
